d: Ready to shape a seamless end-to-end Credit and Lending journey?

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
Credit & Capital Management (C&CM) within CIB has introduced a modern end-to-end operating model including the first line Business Credit Office (BCO).

This role supports Relationship Managers and Coverage teams by bringing credit management into a single control point across structuring, credit analysis, rating recommendations and client credit monitoring.

It’s a client-facing role focused on delivering a reliable and predictable underwriting and lending process that protects the bank while responding to clients’ borrowing needs. Success means timely, high-quality credit application and renewal delivery aligned to agreed OKRs, SLAs and KPIs.

You’ll work closely with Coverage and Transaction Support teams to deliver consistent and seamless customer experience. You’ll also help embed strong controls and thoughtful risk escalation across the end-to-end Credit and Lending process.
q: Bring proven experience in finance, accounting or a similar corporate lending role; experience gained in a regional bank or consulting practice would be an advantage.
Proven corporate lending experience with strong analytical capability and sound credit knowledge.
Strong risk assessment and risk management capability to support credit quality and returns on risk
Demonstratable understanding of financing instruments and banking products within Wholesale Banking.
Strong stakeholder management skills to navigate complex situations and align senior leaders
Clear understanding of Group credit risk principles, policies and statutory compliances.
Communicate clearly and influence effectively across a wide range of stakeholders
Partner constructively with risk colleagues to balance commercial outcomes and risk management
Improve productivity and client experience through consistent process discipline and adoption of technology and customer experience initiatives

This is a chance to help embed a consistent first line credit management model that simplifies how Credit and Lending work gets done. The role sits at the point where client needs, credit judgement and control standards come together so the impact is visible in every deal and renewal. If you want to work closely with Relationship Managers, Coverage teams and risk partners while improving the end-to-end servicing journey this role offers real scope. Apply to help deliver a seamless experience for customers and strong outcomes for the bank.
For further details and application information please visit our careers site, searching for reference number.
We support our staff to adopt flexible and alternative ways of working where possible, including working from home and different hours subject to approvals.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
Issued by The Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited
r: li
Deliver BCO tasks in line with agreed OKRs, SLAs and KPIs
li
Own the end-to-end Credit and Lending servicing journey from RM handoff through completion
li
Prepare credit analysis, financial assessment and rating recommendations on behalf of Relationship Managers
li
Coordinate client review and renewal activity including customer outreach and research
li
Negotiate credit terms and documentation with WCMR and clients, acting as a single handoff point for C&L tasks
li
Participate in deal discussions and meetings with clients and credit risk as required
li
Embed first line risk management and control standards across the credit lifecycle to protect the bank
li
Maintain internal control standards including timely implementation of internal and external audit recommendations and addressing issues raised by external regulators

d: We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented HDD Tracker/Locator to join our Bahrain HDD operations team. The successful candidate will be responsible for accurately tracking and guiding the drill head along the approved bore path during Horizontal Directional Drilling operations.

The role is critical to ensuring HDD installations are completed safely, accurately and efficiently while protecting existing underground services and maintaining the required line, level and bore profile.
q: Minimum 5 years' experience working as an HDD Locator/Tracker or experienced HDD rig crew member with demonstrated locating experience.
Proven competence using DigiTrak F5 or similar HDD tracking/locating systems.
Practical understanding of HDD steering principles, drill head orientation, pitch, depth and bore profile control.
Good understanding of underground utilities and safe drilling practices.
Ability to read and understand construction drawings, utility drawings and HDD bore profiles.
Experience maintaining accurate HDD bore and tracking records.
Strong communication skills and the ability to communicate continuously and clearly with the HDD rig operator.
Physically capable of working outdoors and walking the bore alignment for extended periods.
Able to work safely in high-temperature Middle Eastern conditions, including summer working arrangements.
Experience with medium and large HDD rigs on pipeline, water, sewer, power, telecommunications and industrial infrastructure projects.
Previous experience working around live utility networks and congested underground service corridors.
Familiarity with DigiTrak data logging and digital bore-recording systems.
Experience working to client-specific ITPs, RAMS, permit-to-work and utility clearance procedures.
Experience working on major infrastructure, industrial, utility or pipeline projects.
Experience working within multinational HDD crews.
Knowledge of drilling fluids, bore stability and the operational relationship between the locator, driller and mud engineer would be advantageous.
We are one of the UK's leading civil engineering and tunnelling contractors, offering a wide range of construction and specialist services.
r: li
Operate electronic HDD locating and tracking equipment, including DigiTrak F5 or equivalent systems, to determine drill head position, depth, pitch and direction.
li
Provide continuous, accurate information to the HDD rig operator during pilot drilling and steering operations.
li
Read and interpret utility drawings, bore profiles, alignment drawings, topographical information and approved construction drawings.
li
Maintain the drill head on the approved line and level and identify deviations requiring steering correction.
li
Assist the HDD operator and HDD Manager in monitoring bore progress and ensuring compliance with the approved drilling profile.
li
Identify and maintain awareness of existing underground services and known utility crossings throughout drilling operations.
li
Mark bore paths, utility positions and tracking points where required.
li
Maintain accurate bore logs, depth records, pitch readings, rod-by-rod tracking records and as-built information in accordance with the approved ITP and project requirements.
li
Coordinate closely with the drill operator, mud engineer, survey team and HDD ground crew.
li
Immediately communicate unexpected changes in depth, alignment, signal interference or tracking accuracy.
li
Ensure locating equipment is correctly set up, calibrated and maintained.
li
Work in accordance with company SHEQ requirements, project RAMS, permit-to-work systems and client requirements.
li
Participate in daily briefings, toolbox talks and pre-start meetings.
li
Immediately report hazards, service conflicts, near misses and unsafe conditions.
li
Maintain a high standard of housekeeping and equipment care on HDD work sites.

d: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a senior software engineer to join our Kubernetes product team. As a member of that team, you will build the operators and addons; the former, offering complete lifecycle management of mission-critical components, and the latter, a zero-ops experience for seamlessly integrating projects into your Kubernetes.

You will gain familiarity with the latest features in Kubernetes and look to incorporate the best of open-source to bring functionality to our end-users. You will collaborate with industry peers and partners to bring the right solutions to our customers.
This is an exciting opportunity for a senior software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, Golang, Python and Kubernetes.
Location: This is a remote position available in EMEA and the Americas.
q: You are a Golang developer also fluent in Python
You have strong written and verbal communication skills
You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
You love technology and working with brilliant people

d: Cohorts: January yearly | Function: Multiple, apply once and tell us where you want to build

Tamara is Saudi Arabia's first FinTech unicorn, on a mission to help people own their dreams by building the most customer-centric financial super app in the world. There's no playbook for that; our Tamarians are writing it as we go, and we believe potential should be stretched early.

The Flagship Builders Program is our gateway for brilliant minds ready to kick-start their careers. Whether you're a recent graduate or early in your career with up to two years of experience, this is where you'll do real meaningful work, alongside some of the most ambitious people in the region.

This year, we’re keeping things simple: one application gets you into the running for any area you’re interested in. Just share a bit about yourself, highlight what you’re great at, and tell us which teams get you excited. We want you to work on what you’re passionate about, so we’ll look at your interests to match you with a role where you can jump in and start building.
Data Analytics: Get hands-on with the numbers behind millions of transactions. You'll support analytics and reporting that help teams understand customers, measure impact, and make better decisions.
Machine Learning: Turn data into intelligent solutions. You'll explore machine learning models and algorithms that uncover patterns, predict outcomes, and power smarter products and experiences.
Data Engineering: Build the foundations behind millions of data points. You'll work on pipelines, platforms, and infrastructure that transform raw data into reliable, accessible insights.

Data Science: Turn complex data into meaningful discoveries. You'll use statistics, experimentation, and advanced analytical techniques to solve problems, uncover opportunities, and shape business decisions.
